name: Espresso (Basic Shot)
summary: A concentrated shot pulled under pressure — the base for lattes, cappuccinos, and americanos.

steps.title: Dose
steps.instruction: Grind 18g of coffee directly into the portafilter basket.

steps.title: Distribute and tamp
steps.instruction: Distribute the grounds evenly, then tamp firmly and level with consistent, even pressure.
steps.tip: An uneven tamp causes water to channel and creates a sour, uneven shot.

steps.title: Lock in and start
steps.instruction: Lock the portafilter into the group head and start the shot immediately.

steps.title: Pull the shot
steps.instruction: Extract until the scale reads about 36g of liquid in the cup.
steps.tip: Aim for roughly 25–30 seconds; adjust grind finer if it runs too fast, coarser if too slow.

steps.title: Serve
steps.instruction: Stop the shot, remove the cup, and serve immediately while crema is fresh.
